role: The golden (27) and activator (157) rails: straight-only rails whose bit 8 is the powered state, propagated up to 8 rails along the track from a powered rail.

members.name: getIcon
members.note: the oracle dumps getIcon for every (id, meta, side) into rb_table.icon_index; table_icon reads it; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

members.name: func_150058_a
members.note: the along-track search for a powered rail; with redstone off no rail is ever powered, so it always ends false

members.name: func_150048_a
members.note: the powered bit stays clear: every input is zero with redstone off and a fresh rail never carries bit 8 (documented in place.c rail_on_neighbor)

notes: Exact under the world.conf redstone = off rule; the power search itself is not ported and would be needed if redstone comes back. Golden rails generate nowhere in 1.7.10 worldgen.
